bio: CEO @SiamAgriBot | Building autonomous ROS2 laser-weeding & precision harvesting rovers for tropical cassava & sugarcane farms. Former Chulalongkorn Robotics Lab.
discovered_via: SEG-01: SEA Embodied AI & Robotics Founders

recent_posts.text: Field trial results from Nakhon Ratchasima: 3 autonomous rovers ran 140 hours continuously in 38°C mud conditions. Our multi-spectral weed stem classifier hit 96.8% precision while reducing herbicide usage by 82% per hectare.
Looking for 2 senior ROS2 Navigation2 + RTK-GPS sensor fusion engineers in Bangkok who don't mind getting their boots muddy during field calibration.
